t: Hedge trimmer with 50cm laser-cut blades for precise and smooth performance. Adjustable telescopic shaft, with a reach of 165cm, to meet different height requirements. The 150° pivoting trimmer head has 5 settings from -30° to + 90°, for improved versatility. Features electronic quick-stop blade brake for safety. Includes blade tip protector to protect from wear and tear and single shoulder harness with quick-release mechanism.
